title: Cuckoo
blurb: Cuckoos are birds in the family Cuculidae, the sole taxon in the order Cuculiformes. The cuckoo family includes the common cuckoo, roadrunners, koels, malkohas, couas, coucals, and anis.
facts: The coucals and anis are sometimes separated as distinct families, the Centropodidae and Crotophagidae, respectively.
The cuckoo order Cuculiformes is one of three that make up the Otidimorphae, the other two being the turacos and the bustards.
The family Cuculidae contains 150 species, which are divided into 33 genera.
